title: DatasetDescriptor v1
description: Response of GET /api/v1/dataset (public). Drives the synthetic-data banner and the 'As of … · synthetic data' footers (DXD-09, DATA-07). In M0 the source is configuration and state is declared; from M1 the source is the meta schema and state is seeded (ARCH-R028). Bootstrap contract, frozen by CF-0.

asOf.description: Frozen reference date, an Asia/Riyadh calendar day (DR-003, DR-004).

transactionalStart.description: First day of transactional history (2024-01-01, DR-004). Present when state is seeded.
